info.title: FX Tape API
info.description: Collect and inspect one-minute GBP/USD bid, ask, and midpoint OHLC bars.

get.description: Returns bars chronologically within each page. The first page contains the newest bars in the half-open `[start, end)` range. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor` to request the next older page.

parameters.name: start

schema.description: Inclusive UTC range start. A timezone-free value is interpreted as UTC.
schema.title: Start

parameters.description: Inclusive UTC range start. A timezone-free value is interpreted as UTC.

parameters.name: end

schema.description: Exclusive UTC range end. A timezone-free value is interpreted as UTC.
schema.title: End

parameters.description: Exclusive UTC range end. A timezone-free value is interpreted as UTC.

parameters.name: cursor

schema.description: Exclusive upper-bound cursor returned as `next_cursor` by the prior page.
schema.title: Cursor

parameters.description: Exclusive upper-bound cursor returned as `next_cursor` by the prior page.

parameters.name: limit

schema.description: Maximum number of bars returned in one page.
schema.title: Limit

parameters.description: Maximum number of bars returned in one page.

get.summary: Calculate metrics for one or more UTC calendar days
get.description: Pass `day` for one day, or pass both `start` and `end` for a half-open batch range. `average_open_close` is `(open + close) / 2`; `average_high_low` is `(high + low) / 2`.

parameters.name: day

schema.description: Single UTC calendar day in `YYYY-MM-DD` format.
schema.title: Day

parameters.description: Single UTC calendar day in `YYYY-MM-DD` format.

parameters.name: start

schema.description: Inclusive first UTC day in a batch range.
schema.title: Start

parameters.description: Inclusive first UTC day in a batch range.

parameters.name: end

schema.description: Exclusive last UTC day in a batch range.
schema.title: End

parameters.description: Exclusive last UTC day in a batch range.

parameters.name: cursor

schema.description: Exclusive upper-bound day returned by the previous batch page.
schema.title: Cursor

parameters.description: Exclusive upper-bound day returned by the previous batch page.

parameters.name: limit

schema.description: Maximum periods returned in one batch page.
schema.title: Limit

parameters.description: Maximum periods returned in one batch page.

schema.title: Response Get Daily Metrics Api V1 Metrics Daily Get

get.summary: Fetch and store one daily OHLC bar from Interactive Brokers
get.description: Requests a `1 day` historical bar directly from IB Gateway and returns the bar whose IB session date matches `day`. A successful result is idempotently stored in the database's dedicated `ib_daily_bars` table.

parameters.name: day

schema.description: IB session date in `YYYY-MM-DD` format.
schema.title: Day

parameters.description: IB session date in `YYYY-MM-DD` format.

get.summary: Fetch and store one weekly OHLC bar from Interactive Brokers
get.description: Requests a `1 week` historical bar directly from IB Gateway and returns the bar whose IB date belongs to the requested Monday-based ISO week. A successful result is idempotently stored in the database's dedicated `ib_weekly_bars` table.

parameters.name: week

schema.description: IB bar's ISO week in `YYYY-Www` format.
schema.title: Week

parameters.description: IB bar's ISO week in `YYYY-Www` format.

get.summary: Fetch and store one monthly OHLC bar from Interactive Brokers
get.description: Requests a `1 month` historical bar directly from IB Gateway and returns the bar whose IB date belongs to the requested calendar month. A successful result is idempotently stored in the database's dedicated `ib_monthly_bars` table.

parameters.name: month

schema.description: IB bar's calendar month in `YYYY-MM` format.
schema.title: Month

parameters.description: IB bar's calendar month in `YYYY-MM` format.
